mountpoint.description: Mountpoint path for the fused file. Must be specified for actual mounts; optional for -dump/-push.

fragments.description: Ordered list of source file fragments. Each item defines a region of a source file to include in the fused output. See 'fragment' schema for details.

overlay.description: Overlay configuration: either a single overlay file, or an ordered list of overlay files. Use 'type' field to disambiguate.
